statements.impact_statement: Only pip 26.2.1's pure-Python vendored copy has this version in Zeus. pip's cache serializer uses one-shot pack/unpack calls and does not reuse a streaming Unpacker after errors. The separately installed msgpack is 1.2.2. This assessment is limited to the pinned pip bundle.

pip 26.2.1 vendors only pkg_resources from setuptools 70.3.0; it does not include setuptools/package_index.py containing the vulnerable PackageIndex.download code. The separately installed setuptools is 84.0.0. This assessment is limited to the pinned pip bundle.
